gloss: desired amount; requested amount of money

definitions.explanation: The amount of money one wishes to receive, borrow, charge, or be paid. {希望額|きぼうがく} is a standard term in salary negotiations, loan applications, fundraising, donation requests, sales price negotiations, and similar contexts where one party states their preferred figure.

examples.japanese: {希望額|きぼうがく}を{記入|きにゅう}する。
examples.english: To fill in the desired amount.

examples.japanese: {融資|ゆうし}の{希望額|きぼうがく}を{聞|き}かれた。
examples.english: I was asked the loan amount I wanted.

examples.japanese: {面接|めんせつ}では{年収|ねんしゅう}の{希望額|きぼうがく}も{尋|たず}ねられた。
examples.english: At the interview, I was also asked my desired annual salary.

examples.japanese: {売却|ばいきゃく}の{希望額|きぼうがく}を{相場|そうば}より{高|たか}く{設定|せってい}しすぎると、{買|か}い{手|て}が{なかなか}つかない{恐|おそ}れがある。
examples.english: If you set your asking price too far above market rates, there is a risk that buyers will be hard to find.

notes:
{希望額|きぼうがく} is the amount of money one wishes to receive or pay. It appears most commonly on application forms, in negotiations, and in transaction listings.

FORMATION:
- {希望|きぼう} ("hope, wish, desire") + {額|がく} ("amount of money") → {希望額|きぼうがく}

TYPICAL CONTEXTS:
- {年収|ねんしゅう}の{希望額|きぼうがく}: desired annual salary (job applications, interviews)
- {融資|ゆうし}の{希望額|きぼうがく}: requested loan amount
- {売却|ばいきゃく}{希望額|きぼうがく}: desired sale price (real estate, used cars)
- {寄付|きふ}の{希望額|きぼうがく}: suggested donation amount
- {査定|さてい}{希望額|きぼうがく}: desired appraisal amount

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {希望額|きぼうがく}を{記入|きにゅう}する: to fill in the desired amount (on a form)
- {希望額|きぼうがく}を{伝|つた}える: to communicate the desired amount
- {希望額|きぼうがく}を{下回|したまわ}る: to fall below the requested amount
- {希望額|きぼうがく}を{下|さ}げる / {上|あ}げる: to lower / raise one's requested amount
- {希望額|きぼうがく}に{届|とど}かない: to not reach the requested amount

SIMILAR / RELATED TERMS:
- {希望|きぼう}{価格|かかく}: desired price — used in sales contexts; closely related but emphasizes the price tag of an item rather than a sum of money in general
- {希望|きぼう}{年収|ねんしゅう}: desired annual income (a frequent collocation in job applications)
- {見積|みつ}もり{額|がく}: estimated/quoted amount — what is offered, not what is requested
- {提示|ていじ}{額|がく}: offered amount, the amount put forth (e.g., by an employer or buyer)
- {目安|めやす}: rough guideline, ballpark figure — softer than {希望額|きぼうがく}
- {予算|よさん}: budget — the amount one has set aside, not necessarily what one wants

USAGE NOTES:
- On Japanese application and questionnaire forms, you will frequently see fields labeled simply {希望額|きぼうがく} with a numeric input.
- {希望額|きぼうがく} is neutral in formality; it is used in business letters, contracts, and form labels alike.
